# frostmoln_messaging_vhost (Data Source)

Look up a vhost on a managed messaging (LavinMQ) instance by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "frostmoln_messaging_vhost" "orders" {
  instance_id = "mq_B352H9idUJP6jTWtom31nW"
  name        = "orders"
}

output "orders_vhost_status" {
  value = data.frostmoln_messaging_vhost.orders.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The id of the messaging instance.
- `name` (String) The vhost's name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the vhost was created.
- `failure_message` (String) The last failed change's reason in words, or null.
- `failure_reason` (String) The stable code of the vhost's last failed change, or null.
- `id` (String) The vhost's id, `<instance_id>/<name>`.
- `status` (String) The vhost's status: `pending`, `ready`, `deleting` or `error`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the vhost last changed.
